entry.name: matrixctrl
entry.description: Provides a user interface control containing a group of cells in a grid. Cell states can either be on/off or incremental steps. This object is especially useful for controlling the matrix~ object.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Togglesto ignore or respond to mouse clicks, respectively. By default,responds to mouse clicks.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: autosize
attributes.description: Toggles automatically resizing to rows and columns for theobject's display area when a cell picture is added.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default background color in RGBA format.

attributes.name: bkgndpict
attributes.description: Designates the graphics file that theobject will use for the matrix background image. By convention, theobject uses images saved in Portable Network Graphics (.png) format. If you are using Max on Windows and want to to work with images other than PNG or PICT files, we recommend that you install QuickTime and choose a complete install of all optional components. The symbol used as a filename must either be the name of a file in Max's current search path, or an absolute pathname for the file (e.g. ""). The wordby itself puts up a standard Open Document dialog box.

attributes.name: cellpict
attributes.description: Designates the graphics file that theobject will use for each cell. By convention, theobject uses images saved in Portable Network Graphics (.png) format. If you are using Max on Windows and want to to work with images other than PNG or PICT files, we recommend that you install QuickTime and choose a complete install of all optional components. The symbol used as a filename must either be the name of a file in Max's current search path, or an absolute pathname for the file (e.g. "").

attributes.name: clickedimage
attributes.description: Specifies that the graphics file used by theobject contains an additional image to be displayed when a cell is clicked.

attributes.name: clickvalue
attributes.description: Toggles the click value mode. If themessage is followed by a zero or a positive number, clicking on a cell sets its value to the given number. Ifis followed by a negative number, the matrixctrl object reverts to its default behavior in which clicking a cell increments its value. Themessage allows the use of theobject to create grid editors by creating graphics files which contain a sequence of images, each of which is assigned to a different value; as you click through the sequence of images, the cell image will change to reflect velocity, note, etc.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Sets the default color for a cell in the "on" state in RGBA format.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Sets the number of columns in theobject's display.

attributes.name: dialmode
attributes.description: Determines how individual cells inare activated and if cell values are stored as integers or floats. The default is 0 (off).

choices.digest: Allows cells within the matrix to react to a simple click.
Allows the object to behave like a matrix of dials where a cell will need to be clicked and dragged on to change its value.

Similar to Indexed mode, Gain causes the object to behave like a matrix of dials where a cell will need to be clicked and dragged on to change its value. However, this mode is for float gain tracking, where cell values are stored as floats.

attributes.name: dialtracking
attributes.description: Sets whether or not theobject will use vertical mouse tracking while it is in.

attributes.name: elementcolor
attributes.description: Sets the default color for a cell in the "off" state in RGBA format.

attributes.name: horizontalmargin
attributes.description: Sets a horizontal margin (in pixels) between the outermost cells and the edge of the matrixctrl object's bounding box.

attributes.name: horizontalspacing
attributes.description: Sets the horizontal distance (in pixels) between adjacent cells in the matrixctrl object.

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: imagemask
attributes.description: Specifies that thecell graphics file has additional rows of images for use as image masks. This attribute is present for legacy support - it has been superseded by the use of alpha channels in images.

attributes.name: inactiveimage
attributes.description: Specifies that thecell graphics file has additional rows of images for use in an inactive state (set with anmessage).

attributes.name: invisiblebkgnd
attributes.description: Specifies that thewill be drawn without a background image, and its cells will be superimposed over any underlying Max objects.disables this feature.

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: one/matrix
attributes.description: Toggles only allowing one cell in the entire object to have a non-zero state. Setting any other cell in the matrix to a non-zero state causes any other non-zero cells to change to the zero state.removes this constraint.

attributes.name: one/row
attributes.description: Toggles only allowing one cell per row to have a non-zero state. Setting any cell in a row to a non-zero state causes any other non-zero cells to change to the zero state.removes this constraint.

attributes.name: parameter_enable
attributes.description: Enables use of this object withandin Max.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: A mouse click on a cell will increase its value by one. Values inwill wrap back to 0 once they have reached their maximum possible state. Dragging across several cells will set their values to that of the first cell clicked. Dragging across cells while holding down the Shift key will allow you to drag in straight horizontal or vertical lines only.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: causesto dump its current state in lists of three values for each cell pair, in the formathorizontal-coordinate vertical-coordinate value

messages.name: bkgndpicture
messages.description: This is a legacy message - it has been superseded by theattribute.

messages.name: cellpicture
messages.description: This is a legacy message - it has been superseded by theattribute.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: The wordwill set the value of all cells to 0.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.description: The wordfollowed a symbol naming a Max dictionary object, replaces all existing cell states with the ones in the dictionary. If the dictionary has no cell states, the existing connections are cleared. The format of the dictionary is an entry named "connections" containing an array of dictionaries, each one with entries for "in" (row), "out" (column), and "gain" (cell value).

messages.name: disablecell
messages.description: The word, followed by a list of number pairs which specify the horizontal and vertical coordinates of a cell or cells, sets the designated cell or cells so that they do not respond to mouse clicks. Themessage expects at least one pair of numbers, but more may be added to disable multiple cells (e.g.,). Although disabled cells will ignore mouse clicks, their values can be set using messages.

messages.name: enablecell
messages.description: The word, followed by a list of number pairs which specify the horizontal and vertical coordinates of a cell or cells, will set any designated cell or cells which have been disabled using themessage to respond to mouse clicks again. Themessage expects at least one pair of numbers, but more may be added to enable multiple cells (e.g.,).

messages.name: getcolumn
messages.digest: Get all cell states in one column
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sends the values of the cells in the column designated by the number out its right outlet. Column numbers start at 0.

messages.name: getrow
messages.digest: Get all cell states in one row
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sends the values of the cells in the row designated by the number out its right outlet. Row numbers start at 0.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set a group of cell states
messages.description: A list of ints sets cells in theobject using the format . Multiple triplets of values can be used to set more than one cell. Coordinates for the cells start at 0 in the upper-left hand corner and the values for each cell start at 0 and go up to the value range minus one, set by the object's inspector. Substituting the symbolsandin place of the value will increment or decrement that cell coordinate by a value of one. Changing the cell state with a list causes the list to be output from.

messages.name: readanybkgnd
messages.digest: Read any file for a background image
messages.description: The wordfollowed by the name of a file will read any type of file into theobject and attempt to interpret it as a background image.

messages.name: readanycell
messages.digest: Read any file for a cell image
messages.description: The wordfollowed by the name of a file will read any type of file into theobject and attempt to interpret it as a cell image.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set cell states with no output
messages.description: The word, followed by a list as described above, changes the state ofwithout echoing the values to the output.

inlets.digest: bang Outputs All Cells, list Sets Cells
